_readme: Every payload here is the TEXT that a completed MCP `tools/call`
round-trip returned with `isError: true`. The round-trip itself
succeeded in all cases — these are what the *server* said, not what
The `application` entries are synthetic reproductions of the shapes
that manufactured fake hosted-server outages: three consecutive
schema-validation rejections were enough to trip a *reachability*
breaker and black out every tool on that server. No payload here was
captured by sending an invalid request to a live production server;
they are hand-written to the documented error shapes.
The `transport` entries are the narrow set that must KEEP counting
as breaker strikes: real transport/auth failures that some servers
tunnel out through `isError` instead of raising.

application.why: Renderer emitted malformed markup; the tool rejected it. Server is fine.
application.text: Validation failed: `html_notes` is not valid XML. Unexpected end of input: expected closing tag </body> (line 1, column 214).

application.why: Unsupported element in a rich-text field — a payload bug, not an outage.
application.text: Invalid request: html_notes contains unsupported element <table>. Allowed elements: <body> <h1> <h2> <ul> <ol> <li> <strong> <em> <code> <a>.

application.why: Third consecutive validation rejection — the exact count that used to trip the breaker.
application.text: Validation failed: `html_notes` is not valid XML. EntityRef: expecting ';' (line 1, column 88). Raw '&' must be escaped as '&'.

application.why: Upstream 404 for a bad gid. The server answered; the object does not exist.
application.text: Not Found: task with gid '1209999999999999' does not exist.

application.why: Permission decided by the application, not by the transport's auth layer.
application.text: You do not have write access to this project. Ask a project admin to grant you edit permission.

application.why: Schema mismatch on the call arguments.
application.text: Invalid arguments for tool 'create_task': required property 'workspace' is missing.

application.why: Application-level throttle. Retryable later, but the server is plainly reachable.
application.text: Rate limit exceeded for this workspace. Retry after 30 seconds.

application.why: Unreadable error is not evidence of unreachability — must not strike the breaker.
The tool's own operation timed out server-side; bare 'timed out' must not read as transport.
application.text: The report generation timed out after 60 seconds. Narrow the date range and try again.

application.why: Adversarial: a parser position that happens to be a gateway status number. A bare \b503\b marker would re-manufacture the very outage this fix removes.
application.text: Validation failed: `html_notes` is not valid XML. EntityRef: expecting ';' (line 1, column 503).

application.why: Adversarial: line 401 must not read as HTTP 401.
application.text: Invalid request: unexpected token at line 401, column 12 of the submitted document.

application.why: Adversarial: a byte offset colliding with a gateway status number.
application.text: Parse error at offset 502: expected '>' to close the opening tag.

application.why: Adversarial: applications say 'forbidden' about their OWN permission rules. Only '403 Forbidden' is a transport marker.
application.text: Forbidden by workspace policy: guests may not create tasks in private projects.

application.why: Adversarial: status-like numbers appearing as plain data.
application.text: Bulk import rejected: 403 of 504 rows failed validation. Fix the rows and resubmit.

transport.why: Server reports an auth failure through isError rather than raising.
transport.text: Upstream returned 401 Unauthorized: the access token is invalid or has expired.
403 Forbidden — token lacks the required scope.

transport.why: Gateway failure in front of the MCP server.
transport.text: 502 Bad Gateway: upstream service did not respond.
Service Unavailable: the backend is temporarily offline.

transport.why: Socket-level failure surfaced as a tool error.
transport.text: Connection refused while contacting the upstream API (ECONNREFUSED).

transport.why: Transport-level timeout, distinct from an application timeout.
transport.text: Connection timed out after 30s while reaching api.example.internal.

transport.why: Name resolution failure is a transport failure.
transport.text: Temporary failure in name resolution for host api.example.internal.
SSL error: certificate verify failed (unable to get local issuer certificate).

transport.why: Credential expiry must keep its re-auth handling.
transport.text: The token has expired. Please re-authenticate and try again.

transport.why: A status code labelled as one counts even without its reason phrase.
transport.text: Upstream request failed with HTTP 503 while proxying the call.

transport.why: 'status code: 502' is an unambiguous transport report.
transport.text: Proxy failure — status code: 502 returned by the origin.

transport.why: Node/libc DNS retry failure. Codex review flagged this as a miss.
transport.text: request to https://api.example.internal failed, reason: getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN api.example.internal

transport.why: Node's wording for a dropped connection. Codex review flagged this as a miss.
transport.text: Request to the upstream API failed: socket hang up

transport.why: Envoy/Istio sidecar wording for an unreachable upstream.
transport.text: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers
